title: Getting started with Claude Tag
format_note: Narrated tour of Claude inside Slack: one 83 s continuous screen-recording shot, then short feature chapters introduced by serif title cards on a sage ground.
one_thing: Claude joins your team's Slack channel, works in view with progress steps and permission prompts, remembers instructions, and admins control its access.

transcript.voice_style: Calm, explanatory narrator; full sentences, second person, no hype words; reads the two sample prompts aloud.
transcript.script_shape: Claim, then channel setup, sample task, tool access, collaboration, memory, availability and controls, then a one-line invitation to tag Claude in.

structure.frame0: Sage-green ground with hand-drawn pale wavy lines; the kinetic title '@Claude works with your whole team' is already building (first word at 0.07 s, complete by 0.77 s).
structure.first_3s: Title completes within 0.77 s and holds still on sage until the cut at 4.71 s to the Slack window; narrator states the whole premise in the first 5 s.

beats.what: Title card '@Claude works with your whole team', accent underline under @Claude.
Slack window opens on ticket-sales, cursor moves to event-prep; Claude's 'Just joined' message appears.
User types a long prompt into the composer: compile outstanding action items from threads, Drive, Asana.
Thread panel slides in; Claude's four-step checklist ticks off, then the outstanding-items report with links.
Follow-up request, permission prompt with Allow / Don't allow, then calendar booked and Monday status update scheduled.
Second thread: keynote speaker cancelled, Claude's five-step checklist runs under 'Claude is working...'.
Hand-drawn phone outline draws on, lock-screen notification, then the Slack mobile thread with three speaker picks.
Chapter title 'Claude learns your team over time', words dissolve one by one before the cut.
Memory: 'remember for this channel' message, saved-memory thread, waitlist alert request, event checklist saved.
'Claude Tag is available on' with Team and Enterprise plan cards.
Configure Claude for #event-prep card beside titles about tool control, per-channel access and privacy.
'Tag @Claude in on your team's next task' under a 'Let's go!' message card.
Cream end cards: Claude logo, Claude Academy, claude.com/learn; silence from 174.1 s.

hero_moment.what: Thread panel zoomed in, Claude's checklist completes and the outstanding-items report lands with a red flag line and two links (f0045-f0049).

ending.cta_text: Tag @Claude in on your team's next task; claude.com/learn
ending.what: Three cream end cards (logo, Claude Academy, URL) over a silent final 5 s; the CTA line sits on the sage ground 6 s earlier.

rhythm.how_change_is_paced: One 83.5 s shot (46.6 % of runtime) carries the first demo through UI state changes and a virtual camera that zooms and pans; later chapters cut at 88, 91, 97, 103, 140, 144, 167 and 173 s. No burst.

look.ground: Muted sage green with hand-drawn pale wavy lines for title and device scenes; cream (#faf8f3-like) for end cards; white Slack and settings windows float on the sage.
look.accent_use: One terracotta hand-drawn underline under @Claude in the opening title; the Claude asterisk icon and logo carry the orange afterwards.
look.type: Warm high-contrast serif in near-black for titles, sentence case, one to two lines; real Slack sans for UI; words in titles fade in one at a time and fade out in reading order.

look.depth: Flat; the Slack window has a soft drop shadow on sage and the phone has a cream bezel. No parallax or 3D.

product_ui.camera_on_ui: Virtual camera zooms 2-3x into the thread panel and composer for each reading moment, then pulls back to the full window; the zoom lands on the text being narrated (f0019-f0034).
product_ui.notes: Zoomed thread panels are large and legible (Claude's report text about 14-20 px at 1280 wide); full-window views have 8-10 px UI text, and the config card's helper text is under 7 px.

motion.text_entry: Titles build word by word: each word fades from grey to black within about 0.1-0.2 s, next word starting before the last finishes (strips/window-01-0.034s.jpg); exit is the same word-by-word fade in reading order (window-48).
motion.ui_motion: Typing is simulated character by character with a caret; the thread panel slides in from the right; checklist items change from circle to check to asterisk in turn; buttons get cursor hover then click.
motion.camera: Smooth zoom and pan inside the UI (f0019 to f0022 pan to the thread); at 125.9 s the view blurs into motion blur between panes (strips/window-60-125.943s.jpg).
motion.eases: Soft ease in and out; the phone outline is drawn on with a hand-drawn stroke over about 0.8 s (strips/window-41-88.188s.jpg).

transitions.cause: Title card ends, window appears; each chapter title cuts to its demo.

Drawn phone outline fills with the lock-screen, then notification cross-fades to the app thread.
Camera pans between thread panes with motion blur.

copy.holds_vs_reading_rule: Title cards hold 4-6 s for 6-9 words, against the 3.2-3.5 s the 0.5 s + 0.3 s a word rule asks; the last line (URL) holds about 2 s, at the minimum.

sound.music: Describe tags: speech 0.842, music 0.628, keyboard_musical 0.282, plucked_string_instrument 0.242; no steady beat (confidence 0.14), so a soft keyboard/plucked bed with no pulse.
sound.sfx: No sfx evidence in the measurements; onsets average 21.4 strong per minute but the tags name none.
sound.vo_music_balance: Narration is the dominant layer (speech 0.842 vs music 0.628); loudness range only 3.6 LU, so the mix is flat.
sound.energy_arc: Flat 3.6 LU range, short-term max -12.9 LUFS; 14 sections with no drop or build, then silence from 174.1 s to the end.
sound.sync_to_picture: Cuts are not locked to the sound: cuts_on_strong_onset_share 0.0 against chance_share 0.079; picture is paced to the narration.

good.observation: The hook is the product claim itself: a 6-word title is complete by 0.77 s, and the narrator says the same promise at 0 s.
Real Slack UI carries the film (about 80 % of runtime), so every narrated capability is shown as a message, thread or button rather than described.
The camera zooms to the exact panel being narrated, making UI text 14-20 px at 1280 wide while the full window stays in context.
Trust is shown as UI: Allow / Don't allow permission prompt and a 'Stop' button appear in the flow at the moment the narration says 'asking for permission every time'.
Chapter titles are plain sentence-case serif on one colour with the same word-by-word build, so each new chapter reads instantly and the film stays calm.
The mobile scene is introduced by a hand-drawn phone outline that fills in, a cause-and-effect handoff from desktop to phone.

weak.observation: Peak is above ceiling and loudness is at the target: true peak +0.5 dBTP against the -1 dBTP limit.
Fine UI text in full-window views is below 7 px of glyph height (config helper text, thread meta), which is unreadable on a phone.
One 83.5 s shot is 46.6 % of runtime with no burst and few cuts; pace depends entirely on narration.
Chapter title cards hold 4-6 s with 6 words, longer than the reading time, and the config scene shows a still card for about 22 s.

rule_candidates.rule: In a walkthrough, zoom the camera 2-3x onto the panel being narrated so UI text reaches 14 px or more at 1280 wide, then pull back to the full window.
rule_candidates.evidence: f0019/f0034 zoomed vs f0004 full-window text 8-10 px.

rule_candidates.rule: Build titles word by word, each word fading in 0.1-0.2 s with the next starting before the last settles, and fade them out in reading order.
A walkthrough may use one long continuous screen-recording shot of 80 s or more if UI state changes every 2-6 s; cut counts then measure chapters, not pacing.
Show a permission prompt (Allow / Don't allow) inside the demo at the same second the narration names the trust control.
rule_candidates.evidence: f0034 at 66 s; transcript [01:00] 'asking for permission every time'.

rule_candidates.rule: Hand off between device scenes with a drawn outline that fills with the next screen instead of a cut or dissolve.
rule_candidates.evidence: strips/window-41-88.188s.jpg: outline drawn 88.2-88.8 s, screen fills 88.96 s.

rule_candidates.rule: Master loudness check must include true peak: this film sits at -14 LUFS but true peak is +0.5 dBTP.
A demo-led film can run chapter titles at 4.4-6 % of frame height beside a UI card, rather than 11 % hero titles.
rule_candidates.evidence: title_measurements 32 px (4.4 %) at 145 s, 43 px (6.0 %) at 141 s.

rule_candidates.rule: End on silence: stop the music and narration, show the logo then URL on a plain cream ground for at least 5 s.
rule_candidates.evidence: silence_spans from 174.1 s; logo f0088, URL f0090.

unchecked: Sound was judged from tags and loudness only; no listening, so music genre is unconfirmed.
